SignalType.description:
Every health indicator the system understands.

Adding a signal: add it here AND to the registry in ``signals.py``.
A test fails if the two ever get out of sync.
SignalType.title: SignalType

Source.description: Where a reading came from (the channel, not whether it is simulated).
Source.title: Source

description:
One health reading for one astronaut at one moment.

Example::

    Observation(
        astronaut_id="AST-01",
        timestamp="2026-03-01T06:00:00Z",
        signal="skin_temp",
        value=34.6,
        source="wearable",
    )

``unit`` may be omitted and is then filled with the signal's canonical
unit. If given, it must match exactly, which catches °F/°C mix-ups.

timestamp.description: When the reading applies, in UTC. For nightly summaries, use the wake-up time.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

unit.description: Must equal the signal's canonical unit.
unit.title: Unit

simulated.description: True for data produced by the mission simulator.
simulated.title: Simulated
